FN-FVFV5CD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 103
Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs Sponsor: Representative Kenneth Paschal
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 103 as introduced would codify the current practice of the Alabama Department of
Veterans Affairs of employing an executive director for the Alabama State Veterans Home
program, as well as an on-site director for each state veterans home.
Additionally, this bill could increase the obligations of the department, beginning in Fiscal Year
2025, by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in: (1) the current per diem paid
to board members, set by statute at $25 per day; and (2) the per diem set by the board, pursuant
to this bill.
